candidate_replacement.mechanism_description: Rift2Core's build.sc resolves Chisel as the pre-compiled Maven artifact org.chipsalliance::chisel:5.1.0, so this source unit has no .scala file inside the CPU checkout that a candidate could overwrite. harness/evaluate.sh substitutes the candidate at the same definition boundary instead. It inserts the candidate class Queue definition into harness/chisel_5.1.0_Decoupled.scala, which is the file at the recorded revision (SHA-256 df28be6ddc2f193f6c02efb21e1bbb484d5d6b07b95bb4a3fcc223110c0d908a) with the class Queue definition at lines 244-326 replaced by one marker line, so inserting the upstream class reproduces that file byte for byte. It then compiles that one file in a throwaway mill module against the released chisel 5.1.0 artifacts under Scala 2.13.10 and the chisel 5.1.0 compiler plugin, patches the resulting chisel3/util/*.class files into a private per-run copy of the chisel jar, and points COURSIER_CACHE at that private cache for Rift2Core's ordinary elaborate-and-simulate flow. Nothing outside class Queue changes, and the shared pristine cache mirror is only read.

replaceable_region.description: The class Queue[T <: Data](...) extends Module() declaration and body, at these lines of the upstream file, is not in the template; the candidate replaces the template's marker line 244. The QueueIO bundle, the Queue companion object, and every other definition in the file are fixed.

cpu.instantiation_sites: The candidate definition replaces every Queue instance in the design.
cpu.reset_convention: Rift2Core parents discard queued state through the module reset input. The cancellation signal depends on the parent: the shown ALU and Issue connections use io.flush, while CsrScoreBoard uses io.isAbort.

test_programs.policy: Before compilation, require all 103 programs selected from ../_shared/required-test-catalog.json by the selection patterns, with both executable and memory initialization files present. A test-name override must retain every required program. Run the resulting complete selected set.

comparison.pass_condition: Every selected program reaches a terminal state, ends with Rift2Core's own Pass! line, has zero RTL-versus-ISA trace mismatches, and produces no CPU_EVAL_OBSERVATION_MISMATCH marker from the fixed integration probe. The three-entry flow Queue probe must complete with the expected ready/valid, FIFO data, occupancy and reset behavior.

fixed_test_patches.purpose: Check the occupancy and pipe-ready contract of Rift2Core's one-entry ALU write-back Queue from handshake events observed outside the replaceable Queue definition.
Generate a separate instance of the same three-entry flow Queue configuration used by the L2 SourceD readout.
